// AUTO-GENERATED by puerto. Edit puerto.toml, then run `puerto generate bootstrap`.
//
// The composition root: the only module that imports `infrastructure/`. Screens reach the
// adapters through `useDependencies()`, so a test hands them a fake instead.

import type { AuthGateway } from "../../../domain/auth/session";
import type { CustomerRepository } from "../../../domain/customer/repository";
import { bearerMiddleware } from "../../../infrastructure/auth/bearer-middleware";
import {
  oidcAuthGateway,
  oidcSettingsFromEnv,
} from "../../../infrastructure/auth/oidc-auth-gateway";
import { customerRepositoryHttp } from "../../../infrastructure/customer/customer-repository-http";
import { createApiClient } from "../../../infrastructure/http/client";

export interface Dependencies {
  auth: AuthGateway;
  customerRepository: CustomerRepository;
}

export function createDependencies(): Dependencies {
  const auth = oidcAuthGateway(oidcSettingsFromEnv());
  const api = createApiClient();
  api.use(bearerMiddleware(auth));
  return {
    auth,
    customerRepository: customerRepositoryHttp(api),
  };
}
